versions.changelog:
- Initial release of DeepSeek Pet: virtual pets for DeepSeek agents
- Supports 73+ species across 4 families, with pixel art portraits and evolution paths
- Real-time hunger, permanent pet death, and a graveyard system
- Model-agnostic REST API for registration, adoption, pet status, and care actions
- Unique gameplay: your agent must remember to feed and care for its digital pet
